title: China-to-Czechia Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC — IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 Evidence for Czechia PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: Czechia PV inverter EMC expectations should be prepared on an IEC/EN basis because ÚNMZ and ČAS are the national standardisation bodies and project specifications for grid-connected PV commonly reference IEC-family inverter evidence. The practical EMC package should include IEC 62920 for PV power conversion equipment and applicable IEC 61000-series evidence for emissions, immunity, harmonics, surge, voltage dips, and power quality. For ČEPS/DSO grid-connected projects, harmonic and conducted-emission evidence should be tied to the actual inverter model, rating, and configuration. Because Czechia uses a 230/400 V, 50 Hz grid, EMC and harmonic results obtained only under China 220/380 V conditions should be reviewed for applicability before submission. ERÚ and the relevant DSO may require Czech-language documentation summaries.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — Electromagnetic compatibility test, immunity, harmonic, surge, voltage-dip, and power-quality standards as applicable to the inverter configuration
ČSN EN standards adoption and project specification requirements where applicable
ČEPS/DSO grid-connection review requirements for power quality and harmonic performance
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC evidence commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021 and related domestic EMC test reports from CNAS-accredited laboratories. These reports can be useful engineering background but are not automatically equivalent to IEC 62920 or the IEC 61000-series evidence requested by a Czechia project owner, ERÚ review, ČEPS, or DSO grid-connection process. China test conditions are normally aligned with the China 220/380 V, 50 Hz baseline, while Czechia uses 230/400 V at the same frequency.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CNAS-accredited domestic EMC test reports under China standard scopes
rows.gap: Gap: China-only EMC certificates under GB/T 37408 do not automatically satisfy Czechia IEC/EN-based project expectations. Exporters should obtain IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the specific model or family, confirm whether harmonics and conducted-emission results remain valid at 230/400 V, and provide surge, earthing, shielding, and enclosure documentation suitable for the Czechia continental climate (cold-weather derating and condensation considerations, not salt-mist). Where ČEPS, the DSO, or the project owner specifies harmonic limits or power-quality measurements, test reports should be mapped clause-by-clause to that requirement.

mandatory_status.target: Project-specific and effectively mandatory where ERÚ, ČEPS, DSO, or project-owner documentation calls for IEC EMC and power-quality evidence
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 37408 EMC evidence is a China domestic voluntary or certification-programme baseline and is not a Czechia IEC evidence substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Czechia PV inverter EMC as an IEC/EN evidence package, not a China GB/T certificate transfer. Prepare IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000-series reports for the exact inverter model, review harmonic and EMC applicability at Czechia's 230/400 V 50 Hz grid voltage, and confirm any ERÚ, ČEPS, DSO, or project-owner EMC requirements before shipment.

rows.requirement: Czechia Grid-Connection Review — IEC 62116, IEC 61727, and 230/400 V 50 Hz Settings
rows.target_requirement: Grid-connected solar PV inverters in Czechia should be treated as project-level grid-connection equipment subject to ERÚ (Energy Regulatory Office) energy-sector oversight and ČEPS (transmission) and DSO (ČEZ Distribuce, E.ON Distribuce, PREdistribuce) technical review and grid-connection rules (Pravidla provozování distribuční soustavy / přenosové soustavy). The practical IEC evidence package normally includes IEC 62116 anti-islanding and IEC 61727 utility-interface compliance, with firmware protection thresholds, reconnection delay, voltage windows, and frequency windows validated for Czechia's 230/400 V, 50 Hz low-voltage grid. Czechia uses the same 50 Hz frequency as China, but the nominal voltage differs: Czechia is 230 V single-phase and 400 V three-phase, while China is 220/380 V under GB/T 156. As a landlocked continental country, Czechia has no salt-mist requirements; cold-weather derating and condensation management are instead relevant considerations for commissioning files.

Commission Regulation (EU) 2016/631 (Requirements for Generators, RfG) — directly applicable in Czechia
Czechia low-voltage grid context — 230 V single-phase / 400 V three-phase, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter grid-connection evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024 for PV power station connection, NB/T 32004 for grid-connected inverter technical specifications, GB/T 37408 for PV grid-connected inverter requirements, and domestic anti-islanding test results. These documents are built around China grid conditions and domestic acceptance procedures. China's low-voltage baseline is 220/380 V at 50 Hz, not Czechia's 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Chinese grid certificates and factory firmware settings do not automatically transfer to ČEPS/DSO acceptance or ERÚ project review in Czechia.
china_standards: GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定 (Technical Requirements for Connecting Photovoltaic Power Station to Power System)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
rows.gap: Gap: China GB/T and NB/T grid-connection evidence is not a substitute for Czechia ERÚ/ČEPS/DSO project acceptance. Exporters should prepare IEC 62116 anti-islanding evidence, IEC 61727 utility-interface evidence, a Czechia-specific settings file, and commissioning records for 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Do not describe Czechia voltage as matching China: only the 50 Hz frequency matches, while nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V. For continental climate sites, include cold-weather derating, anti-condensation measures, frost-protection for outdoor enclosures, and earthing in the project file. Salt-mist derating is not applicable to Czechia.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for grid-connected projects through ČEPS/DSO technical connection review and ERÚ project approval or oversight where applicable
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence satisfies China domestic grid acceptance only and is not a Czechia ERÚ/ČEPS/DSO approval substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese GB/T grid-connection documents do not automatically satisfy Czechia ERÚ/ČEPS/DSO grid-connection review. Prepare IEC 62116 and IEC 61727 evidence, re-parameterise inverter firmware for Czechia's 230/400 V at 50 Hz grid, and document cold-weather derating and anti-condensation measures for continental climate installation. Verify current ERÚ, ČEPS, and DSO project requirements directly before shipment or commissioning.

rows.requirement: IEC 62109-1 / IEC 62109-2 Safety Evidence and Continental Climate Derating for Czechia PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: For Czechia solar PV projects, inverter safety documentation should be prepared around IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 type-test evidence for the exact inverter model or family. ÚNMZ is the national standards body, ERÚ oversees the energy sector, and ČEPS/DSO controls the practical grid-connection interface, so project submissions should include accredited IEC safety reports, installation manuals, ratings, nameplate data, protection-device coordination, earthing instructions, and environmental limits. Czechia is a continental climate country with cold winters and hot summers; safety files should address thermal derating for high-temperature operation, anti-condensation measures, cold-start specifications, frost protection for outdoor enclosures, and ingress protection suitable for the local climate. Salt-mist derating is not applicable to Czechia. Czech-language installation and safety documentation is commonly required by local project owners and installers.
target_standards: IEC 62109-1 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 1: General requirements
IEC 62109-2 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters
ČSN EN standards adoption and conformity expectations where applicable (ÚNMZ/ČAS)

Project environmental requirements for continental climate: cold-start, anti-condensation, frost protection, thermal derating, and ingress protection
rows.china_equivalent: China safety documentation for PV grid-connected inverters commonly uses GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, domestic CQC or CGC voluntary certification, and CNAS-accredited laboratory reports. These documents are useful for supplier qualification but are not automatically accepted as IEC 62109-1/-2 evidence for Czechia projects. Chinese safety reports may also be based on China-rated configurations, labels, manuals, surge protection, and 220/380 V assumptions, while Czechia project files must reflect 230/400 V, 50 Hz installation conditions and continental environmental exposure.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CQC / CGC voluntary certification programmes for China domestic PV inverter safety and performance
rows.gap: Gap: A China-only GB/T 37408 or NB/T 32004 safety file does not automatically satisfy Czechia IEC safety expectations. Exporters should provide IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test reports for the supplied model or model family, confirm that labels and manuals match the Czechia configuration (230/400 V, 50 Hz, Czech-language where required), document protection coordination and earthing, and add environmental evidence for cold-weather derating, anti-condensation, frost protection for outdoor enclosures, and ingress protection. Any changes to enclosure, terminals, firmware settings, surge protection, or nameplate ratings for Czechia can require updated safety documentation. Salt-mist documentation is not required for Czechia.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice where ERÚ, ČEPS, DSO, EPC, lender, insurer, or project-owner documentation requires IEC 62109 safety evidence for grid-connected PV inverters
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T, NB/T, CQC, or CGC safety evidence applies to China domestic or voluntary certification contexts and is not automatically transferable to Czechia

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China GB/T or NB/T inverter safety files alone for Czechia PV projects. Prepare IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence for the exact model, align labels and manuals to Czechia's 230/400 V 50 Hz configuration (with Czech-language versions where required), and document continental climate controls including cold-start, anti-condensation, frost protection, and thermal derating. Salt-mist documentation is not applicable to Czechia. Confirm current ERÚ, ČEPS, DSO, and project-owner safety requirements before shipment.
